name: WordArt
what_it_does: Inserts decorative styled text from a gallery; the result is a text object whose selection activates a Format contextual tab (measured: modern WordArt uses Shape Format; legacy WordArt objects surface a dedicated WordArt tab).

connections.why: both create floating text Shapes (both measured to Shape Format context)
measured: inserting/selecting this object makes the contextual tab appear (run step3-contextual probes)
measured: inserting/selecting this object makes the contextual tab appear (run step3-contextual probes)
